### Part 2  

```{r}
# part 2
multiple_outputs <- function(x){
  n = length(x)
  total = sum(x)
  average = mean(x)
  standard_deviation = sd(x)
  out <- c(n, total, average, standard_deviation)
  return(out)
}
multiple_outputs(x)
```

### Part 3 

```{r}
# part 3
multiple_outputs_df <- function(x){
  n = length(x)
  total = sum(x)
  average = mean(x)
  standard_deviation = sd(x)
  out <- data.frame(n, total, average, standard_deviation)
  return(out)
}
multiple_outputs_df(x)
```
